CBJ.head: Not an easy night for the Blue Jackets
CBJ.body: Columbus has home-ice advantage, but Pittsburgh has been out-chancing opponents lately. The Blue Jackets can pull it off if they get good looks.

PIT.head: Advantage, the Penguins
PIT.body: Columbus has home-ice advantage, but Pittsburgh has been out-chancing opponents lately. The Blue Jackets’ way back in is getting good looks.
